description: Gives a team's latest matches that the Desk forecast before they were played. For each line, it gives the team's chance as the Desk logged it the night before, and whether the team won the line. It also gives each match's result. Call it for how the Desk's forecasts did for a team, or what the Desk gave a team in a past match. Pass the team, or nothing for the member's own team. It gives only matches already played, never a chance for a match still to come, which comes with the Desk Pass.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

team.description: The team, e.g. 'Belvedere men's 7.5'. Omit for the signed-in member's own team. Or the team's Desk page link or number.

name: query_forecast_results
title: How past forecasts did
